channel.title: USA Anime Club — US Anime News
channel.description: Source-verified US anime streaming and theatrical news.

item.title: Royal Road's November Writathon Is Underway: What the 55,555-Word Challenge Means
item.description: Royal Road's November 2026 Writathon challenges serial-fiction writers to produce 55,555 words in five weeks. Here's what readers can verify and how to follow it.

item.title: J-Novel Club Adds Putting a Price on World Peace to Its English Digital Lineup
item.description: J-Novel Club lists Daken's Putting a Price on World Peace with digital volume parts available in English. The release is a translated light novel, not a new original web serial.

item.title: Albus Changes the World Makes Its US Manga Debut With Volume 1
item.description: VIZ's first English volume of Albus Changes the World arrived November 10, 2026. Here's the credited creative team and what readers can verify.

item.title: One Piece Volume 113 Reaches US Readers: VIZ Confirms November 10 Release
item.description: VIZ Media lists the US paperback of One Piece Vol. 113 for November 10, 2026, including ISBN, format and the Elbaph-focused synopsis.

item.title: Pokémon Adventures Red and Blue Returns in a New US Deluxe Hardcover
item.description: VIZ released Pokémon Adventures: Red and Blue Deluxe Edition Vol. 1 on November 10, 2026, as a 476-page hardcover with an all-ages rating.

item.title: Hirayasumi Anime Is Heading to Netflix Internationally in January 2027
item.description: VIZ confirms the Hirayasumi anime's January 2027 Netflix window, with Gen Hoshino on opening theme and TOMOO on ending song.

item.title: Omniscient Reader Among 10 Winners of the 2026 World Webtoon Awards
item.description: South Korea's culture ministry named ten 2026 World Webtoon Awards main winners, including Omniscient Reader and The Greatest Estate Developer.

item.title: Otaku Vampire's Love Bite Gets a TV Anime: VIZ Reveals First Teaser
item.description: VIZ announced a television adaptation of Julietta Suzuki's Otaku Vampire's Love Bite on November 3, 2026, with teaser visuals but no premiere date.

item.title: Shiba Inu Rooms TV Anime Announced for Summer 2027 With First Cast
item.description: The supernatural comedy Shiba Inu Rooms is getting a TV anime in summer 2027, with a teaser and initial cast and staff announced.

item.title: The Remarried Empress Volume 11 Has an Official English Print Edition
item.description: Ize Press lists The Remarried Empress Vol. 11 for October 20, 2026 in the US, with the original story and adaptation team credited.
